contract.title: Information Security and Technology Risk Addendum

contract_sections.title: Access Controls
contract_sections.raw_text: Vendor shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all privileged access to Company Data.

contract_sections.title: Authentication and Authorization
contract_sections.raw_text: Vendor shall implement role-based access control and unique user identification for system access.

contract_sections.title: Encryption of Data
contract_sections.raw_text: All Company Data transmitted over public or private networks shall be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.

contract_sections.title: Administrative Access
contract_sections.raw_text: Administrative access shall be performed through a secure gateway with session logging enabled.

contract_sections.title: Personnel Security
contract_sections.raw_text: Vendor shall ensure security awareness training for personnel upon hire and annually thereafter, and conduct background checks as permitted by law.

claims.quote: Vendor shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all privileged access to Company Data.
Vendor shall implement role-based access control and unique user identification for system access.
All Company Data transmitted over public or private networks shall be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.
Administrative access shall be performed through a secure gateway with session logging enabled.
Vendor shall ensure security awareness training for personnel upon hire and annually thereafter.

risk_items.finding: No explicit contractual requirement for password rotation, vaulting of privileged credentials, or protection against compromised passwords.
The contract does not explicitly mandate an IT asset inventory or periodic reconciliation.

compliance_results.rationale: The contract lacks explicit requirements for comprehensive password management controls.
No contractual language was found mandating IT asset inventory or configuration baselines.
Security training and background checks are explicitly required with defined frequency.
The contract explicitly mandates encryption of data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
The contract mandates MFA, RBAC, secure administrative access pathways, and session logging.
